purpose: Hit a soft, short, underspun ball that clears the net and bounces twice near it before the opponent can reach it, using a groundstroke-like preparation to disguise the shot and a compact, controlled high-to-low swing with a slightly open racket face.

phases.description: Ready position and approach to the ball, moving in as for a normal groundstroke.
Shoulder turn and short racket take-back, racket set slightly above the intended contact height.
Short, controlled high-to-low swing with an open racket face, ending at contact in front of the body.
Brief, soft follow-through and balanced recovery.

objectives.goal: Meet the ball out in front of the body with the hitting arm comfortably extended away from the shoulder.

below.looks_like: Ball is taken late and close to the body, arm cramped, shot lacks touch and control.

above.looks_like: Overstretching for the ball, arm fully extended away from the body, losing touch and balance.

objectives.cue_intent: Remind the player to make contact out in front, with room between body and racket.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether they felt the ball was late or jammed against the body.
objectives.fix_intent: Have them set up earlier and step toward the ball so contact happens in front.

objectives.goal: Get down to the ball by bending the knees so the body lowers instead of bending over or reaching down with the arm.

above.looks_like: Standing tall and stabbing down at a low ball, so the ball is hit into the net or too hard.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue the player to sink the hips and bend the knees to get under the ball.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether they are bending at the waist or at the knees to reach low balls.
objectives.fix_intent: Drill shadow drop shots focusing on dropping the hips and keeping the head level at contact.

objectives.goal: Set the racket arm slightly higher than the planned contact point at the end of the backswing so the swing can travel high to low and slice under the ball.

below.looks_like: Racket starts low, swing goes low-to-high and the ball pops up and sits up for the opponent.

above.looks_like: Overly large, high take-back that lengthens the swing and costs touch.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue a short take-back with the racket set above contact height.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the ball is floating up after contact.
objectives.fix_intent: Practise a compact take-back starting high and brushing down and under the ball.

objectives.goal: Keep the hitting arm relaxed with a slightly bent elbow at contact for a soft, controlled touch.

below.looks_like: Elbow tucked tight and cramped, restricting the swing and touch.

above.looks_like: Stiff, locked arm hitting the ball too firmly so it travels deep rather than dropping short.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue a loose, slightly bent arm and a soft touch.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask how firmly the racket was gripped and whether the arm felt stiff.
objectives.fix_intent: Use a lighter grip and a slower, shorter swing to feel the touch.

objectives.goal: Turn the shoulders in the preparation as for a normal groundstroke so the drop shot is not telegraphed.

below.looks_like: Little shoulder turn, an obviously different preparation than the player's groundstrokes, giving the shot away.

above.looks_like: Exaggerated coil that suggests a hard drive and makes the change to a soft touch awkward.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue the player to prepare exactly as for a regular forehand or backhand.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether their preparation looks the same as for a normal groundstroke.
objectives.fix_intent: Alternate drives and drop shots from the same preparation, changing only the swing after the turn.

objectives.goal: Move into the shot with the body weight moving gently forward, staying balanced and under control through contact.

below.looks_like: Leaning back and flicking at the ball with the arm alone, with poor control of length.

above.looks_like: Lunging or falling forward past the ball, off balance and unable to recover.

objectives.cue_intent: Cue stepping toward the ball and staying balanced over the front leg.
objectives.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether they felt balanced or were reaching and off balance at contact.
objectives.fix_intent: Practise stepping into the shot, then holding the finish position for a moment.

outcomes.description: Ball is hit with soft pace and underspin so it bounces near the net, short in the opponent's court.
Ball passes over the net with a small margin rather than being hit into the tape.
The compact stroke shape and balance are performed correctly.

links.mechanism: A lower body lets the racket get under the ball and brush up and over the net rather than stabbing down into it.
A racket set slightly above contact allows a high-to-low cut that produces backspin and a soft, short landing, while a very large take-back adds pace.
Contact in front with moderate arm extension gives the best control of racket face angle and touch.
A relaxed, slightly bent arm absorbs pace and cushions the ball, while a locked arm tends to hit it harder.

session_ideas: Shadow swing drop shots from a baseline ready position focusing on the same preparation as a groundstroke.
Feed drill: coach feeds a ball and the player alternates a deep drive and a drop shot from the same preparation.
Target drill: place a towel or cones just inside the service line and aim to land the ball between the net and the target.
Low-ball drill: practise bending the knees to meet low balls while keeping the head level.

vocabulary_proposals.why: Racket face angle (open face) and racket path high-to-low are central to a drop shot and cannot be seen from body joints alone.

vocabulary_proposals.name: ball
vocabulary_proposals.why: Bounce position, spin and height over the net are the real outcomes of a drop shot.

vocabulary_proposals.name: ball_bounce_distance_from_net
vocabulary_proposals.why: To judge whether the shot actually landed short.

vocabulary_proposals.name: grip_pressure
vocabulary_proposals.why: A relaxed, soft grip is widely coached but not observable with registered features.

vocabulary_proposals.name: racket_face_angle
